data.text: Fix all the bugs in the bug list

data.body: Bug B87d456f1cd: Status.state reports 'registered' for a cli companion that has a leftover MCP config entry but is not installed; state ignores kind while usable/gate_coverage do not. Bug B40760556f6: the 'installed (...)' version probe takes the first output line even when it is noise ('[' for codeguide, an npm warning for memory/sequential). Regression tests must fail on the unfixed code.
data.title: companions: cli companion with a leftover MCP entry is not 'registered'; version probe shows noise (fixes bugs B87d456f1cd, B40760556f6)

data.body: Bug Bf84cccbaa6: duplicate_work WARN says items with the same file set are 'probably a re-description of another'; identical globs is evidence of a conflict, not duplication. Bug B5189cc5756: doctor's remedy for a phase whose tasks are all done says 'ddflow complete <phase>', which exits 3 when the phase's own gates are unrecorded; it should name the unrecorded gates / point at 'ddflow gate status <phase>'.
data.title: doctor: duplicate_work must not claim duplication from identical globs; a done-tasks phase remedy must name its unrecorded gates (fixes bugs Bf84cccbaa6, B5189cc5756)

data.body: Bugs B3eda99e0fe and B5d98a4da0a (same defect): ddflow update <id> --globs on a CLAIMED item widens item.globs but not lease.globs; the commit hook and lease conflict checks read lease.globs, so the documented remedy does nothing. Must not touch ddflow/core/events.py (held by B190).
data.title: update --globs on a claimed item widens the held lease too (fixes bugs B3eda99e0fe, B5d98a4da0a)

data.body: Bug Bd25a0d2adb: ddflow heartbeat <id> run inside that item's own worktree reports 'no lease held' because identity is derived from the tree; check_commit already treats the lease that created this tree as mine, heartbeat does not. Bug Bce34e64d3b: ddflow claim <id> from a DIFFERENT worktree adopts the caller's tree even when the item already records its own worktree with unmerged commits; a merge from there would merge nothing.
data.title: heartbeat from the item's own worktree finds the lease; claim from another worktree does not adopt it over the item's recorded tree (fixes bugs Bd25a0d2adb, Bce34e64d3b)

data.body: Bug B1443180519: 'ddflow session prompt "<words>"' stores the words as the session id and reads stdin: empty at EOF -> 'recorded (0 redaction(s))' with no text; a live tty stdin blocks forever. Refuse empty text (CLI and API/MCP); refuse to read a tty stdin; say what the positional means.
data.title: session prompt refuses empty text and never blocks on an interactive stdin (fixes bug B1443180519)

data.body: Bug B9e8ca361ea: the backlog import titled items 'B157', '+ B159', or cut mid-sentence ('beyond ~100k events the read is still O(log). The tail-parse cache'). Fix the importer so the title is never just the id / a leftover fragment / cut mid-word; then retitle the existing imported items via 'ddflow update --title' events.
data.title: backlog import produces meaningful titles, and the already-imported bare/truncated titles are corrected (fixes bug B9e8ca361ea)

data.claim: Status.state returns 'registered' whenever registered_in is non-empty, regardless of kind; is_installed takes the first line of (stdout or stderr), which is '[' for docker image inspect JSON and an npm warn line for npx probes whose stdout is empty
data.falsifier: Status(cli companion, installed=False, registered_in=['claude']).state != 'registered', or a probe whose stderr leads with 'npm warn' yields a detail not starting with 'npm warn'
data.probe: ddflow companions; raw run of each detect argv (npx ... --help, docker image inspect)
data.probe_output: codeguide: installed ([); memory/sequential: installed (npm warn Unknown user config "email"...). memory/sequential stdout empty, stderr = 2 npm warn lines then '<name> MCP Server running on stdio'. docker inspect stdout starts '['.
data.question: Why does companions report an uninstalled cli companion as registered, and noise as the installed version?
